rationale: Cluster [validate_failed::rule-cheat-sheet] for t05-collection: a collection library passed validator exit 0 with 0 warnings but still failed downstream because the cheat sheet's archetype hint ('Collection / monolith libraries → E11, W2, W4') is too terse — it lists the rules but never spells out the concrete pre-flight steps that prevent asset / homogeneity drift. Adding a named 'Collection / monolith library pre-flight gate' makes the four operations (stat-every-asset, verify-homogeneity, walk-entity-assets, keep-engine-ids) impossible to overlook, and closes the gap where validate-pass ≠ green.
expected_effect: Agents working on collection libraries now have a named, mandatory pre-flight gate with four concrete operations (stat-every-asset, verify-homogeneity, walk-entity-assets, keep-engine-ids). The explicit `fs.existsSync` step and the engine-id-preservation reminder directly address the t05-collection pattern where validate passed but downstream consumers hit missing-asset / dropped-id bugs. The four checks are scoped to the collection archetype, so other archetypes are not burdened.
regression_risk: Adds 4 explicit pre-checks that agents must run before extract on collection libraries; could slightly lengthen time-to-green for collection workflows, but each is a one-shot stat/lookup or structure check rather than a re-run cycle. Risk of breaking id-based / multi-stage / external-json libraries is low since the gate is scoped only to the collection archetype. Existing rule table rows are preserved verbatim — only W4's parenthetical is clarified.
